finding: Native modal under retained hidden Workspace makes reauthentication UI inert
changes: Render modal subtree only while Workspace active; clear modal and mobile navigation state on authentication loss.
Preserve mounted workspace draft and operation recovery state; renewing login never reopens the former dialog.
